categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches block and chainstate flush logic in src/validation.cpp and test files; does not affect transaction relay, mempool acceptance, or policy.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Validation' and modifies FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp to abort disk writes if block or undo data flushes fail.
categories.rationale: Prevents chainstate database corruption and invariant violations when block or undo file flushes fail. Currently, 'When FlushChainstateBlockFile fails, Bitcoin Core requests a shutdown but proceeds to flush block-index metadata and the UTXO set anyway, advancing m_last_flushed_block', which records state as durable on disk even if actual block data is missing or corrupt.
